[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 03:46  
[EVENT] User is planning to host a dinner party soon.  
[EVENT] User is planning to make desserts for the dinner party.  
[FACT] User recently got a KitchenAid stand mixer on sale at Bed Bath & Beyond for $250.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your new stand mixer!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested simple recipes for cakes and cookies that can be made using a stand mixer.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a recipe for Classic Vanilla Cake with the following details:  
- Ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup unsalted butter, 1 3/4 cups granulated sugar, 3 large eggs, 2 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup whole milk  
- Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F, grease two 9-inch round cake pans, cream butter and sugar, add eggs, mix in flour, baking powder, and salt, alternate adding milk and vanilla extract, divide batter, and bake for 30-35 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a recipe for Lemon Pound Cake with the following details:  
- Ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup unsalted butter, 1 3/4 cups granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 2 tbsp freshly squeezed lemon juice, 1 tsp grated lemon zest  
- Instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F, grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan, cream butter and sugar, add eggs, mix in flour, baking powder, and salt, add lemon juice and zest, pour into prepared pan, and bake for 45-50 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a recipe for Chocolate Chip Cookies with the following details:  
- Ingredients: 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup unsalted butter, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 2 large eggs, 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips  
- Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F, line a baking sheet with parchment paper, cream butter and sugars, add eggs, mix in flour, baking soda, and salt, stir in chocolate chips, scoop onto baking sheet, and bake for 10-12 minutes.
